mapper.select: SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(t1.ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.col_id AS colId , t1.col_val AS colVal FROM skt0bm t1 WHERE t1.corp_gr = 'JISU' AND t1.col_id = 'kospi_jisu' ORDER BY t1.ymd DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skt0bm ( corp_gr , ymd , col_id , col_val ) VALUES ( 'JISU' , TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') , 'kospi_jisu' , #{colVal, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
mapper.update: UPDATE skt0bm SET col_val = #{colVal, jdbcType=NUMERIC} WHERE corp_gr = 'JISU' AND col_id = 'kospi_jisu' AND ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM skt0bm WHERE corp_gr = 'JISU' AND col_id = 'kospi_jisu' AND ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD')
